result.instructions: Tools for Blink, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which employees work at location 7, and what is their employee number?"; "Show the details of time record 99."; "Which locations are active in Blink?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Blink data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run blinkde_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run blinkde_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run blinkde_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. blinkde_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: blinkde_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees of the Blink system (number, name, entry and leaving date, time tracking mode, cost centre). OData: GET /odata/v2/Employees.

filter.description: OData $filter, for example: Date ge 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z and EmployeeId eq 12. Not every set supports every filter.

select.description: OData $select: comma-separated property names to return.

skip.description: OData $skip: number of rows to skip (paging).
